components.name: Accordion
components.intent: List of short sections where one opens at a time.

components.name: AlertDialog
components.intent: Overlay that stops the user until they cancel or confirm.

components.name: AnchorNav
components.intent: A list of the sections on one long page, which jumps to a section and shows the one the page is at.

components.name: AppHeader
components.intent: The product's top bar: logo and environment on the start, global search in the centre, utility icons, the user and their company on the end. Not a page title.

components.name: AppNav
components.intent: The app's main navigation: a brand rail of sections on the left, each with an optional second-level menu that flies out beside it.

components.name: Avatar
components.intent: Photo or initials for one person. Not a status chip and not a button.

components.name: AvatarGroup
components.intent: Overlapping row of kit Avatars with a +N count for the rest.

components.name: Badge
components.intent: Short status or category label. Not a person and not a button.

components.name: BadgeAlt
components.intent: Alternate status or category label: tinted fill with a matching border, in three sizes.

components.name: BarChart
components.intent: Values side by side as bars, one group or stack per category, like invoices by status for each week. Bars stand up, or run across with orientation horizontal.

components.name: Breadcrumb
components.intent: Path to the current page as a trail of links.

components.name: Button
components.intent: Triggers an action. One strong brand Button per view.

components.name: ButtonGroup
components.intent: Joined row of kit Buttons that share one size and act as one control cluster.

components.name: Calendar
components.intent: A full calendar of events by month, week, day or as a list, where people browse dates, filter calendars and add, edit or delete events.

components.name: Callout
components.intent: Inline message that stays on the page, with an optional action and dismiss.

components.name: Card
components.intent: One item in a grid or list of options people compare and pick, like a proposal line, product or plan: title, details, a price and a status note, with an optional image and a select checkbox.

components.name: Carousel
components.intent: A track of slides people page through with previous and next buttons, swipe or the arrow keys, like a gallery or featured cards.

components.name: Cascader
components.intent: Pick one item from options that nest several levels deep by walking columns left to right, like a field on a related object (Invoice / Account / Owner) or a region / country / city.
components.statesCovered: hover, focus, selected, disabled, error, empty

components.name: Cell
components.intent: Content for one table cell: text, a number, a date, a link, a redirect to another page, a person, a file, a status, a trend, progress, a switch, row actions or a row menu, a tree row, with an optional row checkbox. Each cell is full width with a faint bottom border.

components.name: ChatComposer
components.intent: The box people write to the assistant in: what the question is about, what is attached, the words, and the toolbar that sends it.

components.name: ChatHeader
components.intent: The bar at the top of the assistant: its mark and name, then start a new chat, go full screen, the options menu and close.

components.name: ChatList
components.intent: The saved chats or playbooks beside the assistant: a titled panel with a search box and rows that open what they name.

components.name: ChatMessage
components.intent: One turn in a chat with the assistant: what the person asked, or what the assistant answered, with its workings, buttons and suggestions.

components.name: Checkbox
components.intent: Checkbox for multi-select and confirmations. Always has a label; the label can be visually hidden.

components.name: Conveyor
components.intent: Arrows at both ends of a row or column that is too long to fit, so people can move it along without a scrollbar.

components.name: Count
components.intent: Small number badge for counts, like unread items on a nav link or tab.

components.name: DataGrid
components.intent: An editable table: people click a cell to add or change its content, like rule conditions, line items or mappings.

components.name: DatePicker
components.intent: A date field that opens a calendar to pick one date, or a range between two dates. Looks like Input.

components.name: Density
components.intent: Sets the density tokens for everything inside it: Compact, Default or Comfortable spacing, control and icon sizes, and font sizes, like the BP Foundations density modes.

components.name: Drawer
components.intent: A panel that slides in from the right edge for a detail view or an edit form about something on the page, while the page stays in view behind it.

components.name: Dropdown
components.intent: A short list of actions or options that opens from a Button or a FilterButton. One component: the trigger and the menu come from props.

components.name: EmptyState
components.intent: What a list, page or panel shows when it has nothing yet: an icon, a title, a line of help and the action that fills it.

components.name: FilterButton
components.intent: Filter chip for lists and tables: shows the filter name or its chosen value, opens its options, and turns an applied filter on or off.

components.name: Form
components.intent: One form: an optional title, kit fields (or titled sections of them) and the actions that save it.

components.name: FormDisplay
components.intent: A read-only label and value, like a form field that shows data instead of editing it.

components.name: FormulaEditor
components.intent: A monospace field for writing formulas and rules, with a toolbar that inserts fields, operators and functions and checks the syntax.

components.name: FunnelChart
components.intent: Steps that narrow, as one solid stack: how many of the ones who started a flow reached each step, like quotes to orders to invoices to payments.

components.name: GlobalSearch
components.intent: A search field over a grouped list of pages, records and actions. Typing filters the list; arrow keys and Enter pick.

components.name: GuidedProcess
components.intent: The pieces of a process walked one step at a time: a dark panel for a step, the dark list of every step beside the page, the header over a step, and the footer under it.

components.name: HeaderCell
components.intent: Column title for a data table: a label in sentence case, optional select-all checkbox, optional sort, with a brand-faint bottom border, 2px or 1px.

components.name: Heatmap
components.intent: A grid where the weight of each cell is its value, like API calls by day and hour, so the busy patches show at a glance.

components.name: HelpPopover
components.intent: A small help panel with an optional title and a short paragraph, opened from a ? icon beside a label or setting.

components.name: Icon
components.intent: Draws one Material Symbols Outlined glyph at a kit size, colored by the parent text color or a semantic icon role.

components.name: Illustration
components.intent: A piece of drawn artwork from the product, like the picture over an empty page.

components.name: Input
components.intent: Single-line text entry with its own label, hint, error and character count. The label sits on top, at the start, or is hidden.
components.statesCovered: hover, focus, active, disabled, error, read-only

components.name: Legend
components.intent: The key to a drawing: a small colour mark per name, so people can read what each colour means.

components.name: LineChart
components.intent: How values change over time as lines or filled areas, one per series, like revenue by month or invoices approved by day.

components.name: Link
components.intent: Inline text that takes people somewhere: a record, a list or another page.

components.name: LinkList
components.intent: A column of links, one a row with a chevron at the end, like an account's quick links.

components.name: ListView
components.intent: A list of records, one a row: a primary and a secondary line with an avatar, icon or image before them, and badges, actions, a chevron or a drag handle after, grouped under headers when the list is long, and stepping into nested lists in place.

components.name: LoadingLine
components.intent: A 2px line with a short brand bar sliding across it, saying a whole page or panel is still arriving when there is no amount done to report.

components.name: Logo
components.intent: Brand logo: the full wordmark or the mark alone, in fixed brand colors.

components.name: LogoAI
components.intent: AI logo for AI features: full logo or icon, in fixed brand colors.

components.name: Lookup
components.intent: A form field for picking one record from a long list, like a product or an account, through a searchable table in a wide Modal.

components.name: Meter
components.intent: How far along or how full something is, from 0 to 100, as a bar, a ring or a half ring, with optional red, amber and green zones.

components.name: Modal
components.intent: A window over the page for a short task, a form or extra detail. People can always close it.

components.name: NavTile
components.intent: A way in to somewhere: the name of a place, a line about what is in it, and a colored icon square. One of a grid of them on a landing page.

components.name: PageHeader
components.intent: The top of a page's content: where it sits (breadcrumb), what it is (title, badge, and an optional icon) and the page actions. Below the AppHeader.

components.name: Pagination
components.intent: The bar under a long table that moves between pages, says which rows are showing, and lets people pick how many rows a page holds.

components.name: PieChart
components.intent: How a whole splits into a few parts, as a donut or a solid pie, like payments by method.

components.name: ProgressBar
components.intent: The older 20-tall progress bar with its percent written on or beside it, for screens that still use the legacy look.

components.name: RadarChart
components.intent: Several measures on one shape: each point of the web is a measure, each series an outline across all of them, so two things can be compared on every measure at once.

components.name: RadioGroup
components.intent: Pick exactly one option from a short visible list. One piece: legend, options, message.

components.name: ScatterChart
components.intent: Two measures against each other, one dot per record, so a pattern between them shows: spend against usage, days late against balance.

components.name: Scoreboard
components.intent: A strip of key numbers at the top of a screen, like open invoices, revenue or overdue amount, each with an optional trend and spark chart.

components.name: Section
components.intent: A titled block of a page, like Account information or Recent invoices: a header with a line under it, optional help and buttons, and the content below. It can collapse.

components.name: Segmented
components.intent: One choice from two to five options, shown as kit minimal Buttons side by side. The chosen one has a brand tint and border.

components.name: Select
components.intent: Choose one or several options from a list. A field that opens the kit Dropdown. Looks like Input.

components.name: Skeleton
components.intent: Gray placeholder shapes in the layout of content that is still loading, like lines of text, an avatar or an image, so the page keeps its shape until the data arrives.

components.name: Sparkline
components.intent: A trend small enough to sit in a table cell or on a tile: the shape of the last few periods, with no axes and no numbers.

components.name: Spinner
components.intent: A small ring of ticks in the brand color that turns while something loads and the wait is short and unknown.

components.name: Steps
components.intent: A row of numbered steps that shows where a person is in a flow of a few steps: done, current and still to come.

components.name: Switch
components.intent: An on/off setting that takes effect right away. A pill track with a sliding thumb. Not a Checkbox.

components.name: Table
components.intent: A semantic table of rows and columns, like invoices or accounts, with optional row selection, a caption and a total.

components.name: Tabs
components.intent: A row of tabs that switches between related views in the same place. The selected tab has a brand label and underline.

components.name: Textarea
components.intent: Multi-line text entry for notes, descriptions and code, with its own label, hint, error and character count. Looks and behaves like Input.

components.name: TextLoader
components.intent: Short text with a soft wave of light running through it, for a moment of work whose end is unknown, like Generating response… or Syncing invoices….

components.name: Timeline
components.intent: What happened on a record, newest first: a circled icon per entry joined by a line, with the note, links and action for each one.

components.name: Toast
components.intent: A short note that floats in after an action, like Saved successfully, and goes away on its own after a few seconds, with an optional Undo. In loading mode it is a small notice that stays while work runs, with a progress bar and a Cancel.

components.name: Toolbar
components.intent: The bar above a list or table: find and filter on the left, view and actions on the right, with a filter bar that opens under it.

components.name: Tooltip
components.intent: Brief extra text on hover or keyboard focus of one trigger. Short and non-essential.

components.name: TreeView
components.intent: A nested list people open and close level by level, like teams in an organization, project folders or account hierarchies, to pick, check or reorder items.

components.name: UsageBar
components.intent: One bar for everything available in a period, split into the parts it is made of: what each part used, what is left, and anything spent past the allowance.

components.name: UsageList
components.intent: A list of usage limits, one a row: the limit's name, how much is used of it, a bar, and a short note, like API calls, storage and seats on a plan.

components.name: WaterfallChart
components.intent: How a balance got from one total to another: an opening total, the rises and falls that moved it, and the closing total.

patterns.name: AccountFlow
patterns.intent: The account provisioning flow: the accounts list, one account with its tabs, a new account, a new product on an account, and configuring that product alone or many products at once, one page at a time.

patterns.name: AppShell
patterns.intent: The frame every product screen sits in: the bar across the top, the rail under it down the side, the page in the middle, and the assistant beside it.

patterns.name: ChatWindow
patterns.intent: The assistant window: its header over the turns, the composer at the foot, and the saved chats coming in beside or over them.

patterns.name: Dashboard
patterns.intent: The home screen of a job: the numbers that matter, grouped, with the charts and lists that explain them.

patterns.name: FormPage
patterns.intent: One record being filled in: its name and the save at the top, anything that has to be read first under that, and the fields in folding groups underneath.

patterns.name: GuidedProcessPage
patterns.intent: A process walked one page per step: a dark column per step before it starts, then each step's fields with every step on a dark panel at the start or end edge of the page.

patterns.name: ListDetail
patterns.intent: A list with the picked record beside it: a ListView on one side and the record in a pane on the other, or one at a time on a phone.

patterns.name: ListPage
patterns.intent: A list of records: the bar to find and filter them, the rows themselves, and the pages under them.

patterns.name: RecordPage
patterns.intent: One record: its name and actions at the top, the tabs of what belongs to it, the numbers that matter, and its details in sections underneath.

patterns.name: SettingsPage
patterns.intent: The settings home: a grid of the places people can go from here, each with its own icon and color.
